label: B
text: On 8 April 2025, BLF militants fired several grenade shells towards a military check post in Qaun area of Tump tehsil (Kech, Balochistan), after which BLF militants claim to have opened fire. BLF claim the attack resulted in an unspecified number of casualties and damages. Casualties unknown.

label: B
text: Around 14 February 2025 (as reported), Pakistan army engaged in sniper fire against military forces of India at Keri sector area (Rajouri district, J&K). One Indian soldier was left injured in the incident.

label: B
text: On 6 June 2025, for the second day in a row, the Dabbashi clan militia and Al Isnad clashed, including with heavy weapons and armored vehicles, in Sabratha (An Nuqat al Khams, West). 5 people were killed. Fighting initially broke out on 5 June when Al Isnad attacked a resort controlled by the Dabbashi clan and set fire to some of its facilities (coded separately). Both militias are involved in illicit economic activities, including migrant smuggling.

label: B
text: On 9 September 2025, a joint team of the District Reserve Guard (DRG) and the Border Security Force (BSF) clashed with the CPI (Maoist) cadres in Kanker district (Chhattisgarh), during a search operation. 1 People's Liberation Guerrilla Army (PLGA) member with a Rs 800000 bounty was killed. The forces recovered a rifle, a wireless set, and other items from the spot.

label: B
text: On 8 July 2025, in Manzanillo, Veracruz de Ignacio de la Llave, members of Los Pinas Gang opened fire at state police officers on the La Tinaja-Cosoleacaque highway near KM 103. Three members of Los Pinas Gang were arrested and officers seized a vehicle and weapons. A second clash took place in a neighboring municipality (coded separately). Casualties unknown.

label: B
text: On 31 December 2024, militants (coded as TTP) opened fire at police personnel at a check post in Daraban area (Dera Ismail Khan, KPK). One police constable and a customs employee were killed, while two others, including a civilian and a police personnel were wounded in the attack. 2 fatalities and 2 injured.

label: B
text: On 10 February 2025, in Belford Roxo (Rio de Janeiro), military police exchanged fire with drug traffickers during an operation in the Jardim Glaucia neighborhood. The operation was aimed at curbing cargo theft. The officers arrested a man who already has a record for drug trafficking and robbery and seized a Colt 5.56 calibre rifle, a magazine, 13 rounds of intact ammunition, two radio transmitters, and a tactical belt. There were no casualties.

label: B
text: On 9 February 2025, in General Bravo, Nuevo Leon, there was an armed clash between armed individuals (likely members of the CDN as bulletproof vests with the initials CDN were seized) and the National Guard. The police seized 12 weapons, among them a Barret rifle and tactical equipment. There were no casualties.

label: B
text: Around 22 September 2025 (as reported), in Puerto Rondon (Arauca), a suspected ELN sniper opened fire on the local police station. There were no casualties.

label: B
text: On 4 September 2025, security forces (coded as military) conducted an intelligence-based operation (IBO) targeting TTP militants in Matta town (Swat, KPK), after receiving reports on the presence of up to 60 militants in the area. During the exchange of fire, two security personnel were killed and two others were wounded. TTP militants are also suspected to have suffered casualties in the clash. At least 2 fatalities and 2 wounded.

label: P
text: On 12 September 2025, students, joined by ABVP members, staged a protest and raised slogans outside a hospital in Bahraich city (Shravasti, Uttar Pradesh) after a student attempted to die by suicide due to harassment by the principal.

label: P
text: On 17 July 2025, demonstrators gathered in Salisbury (North Carolina) to demonstrate against Donald Trump and the Trump administration's 'rollback of democracy,' to honor the legacy of former US Congressman John Lewis, and to call for 'voting rights, justice, and dignity for all.' This demonstration was part of the 'Good Trouble Lives On' day of action.

label: P
text: On 17 July 2025, in Sao Jose dos Campos (Sao Paulo), workers protested in front of the Embraer's headquarters against the 50% tariffs imposed by the US President Donald Trump on Brazilian goods.

label: P
text: On 28 May 2025, residents of Dodial and nearby areas staged protest and blocked the Karakoram Highway in Mansehra district (KPK) against prolonged and unscheduled power outages. Protesters chanted slogans against the government and Peshawar Electric Supply Company (Pesco), demanding an immediate end to daily power cuts exceeding 10 hours.

label: P
text: Around 12 March 2025 (as reported), Department of Mental Health workers with SEIU Local 509 rallied in Worcester (Massachusetts) to oppose the cuts to their agency. The rally was part of 'Care Not Cuts' action.

label: P
text: On 11 September 2025, a small group of demonstrators, including members of Turning Point USA, rallied in Indian Harbour Beach (Florida) to stand with Donald Trump, to show support for Charlie Kirk, and to call for justice for Kirk's death. There was one man who was flying a Three Percenters flag.

label: P
text: On 24 September 2025, in Bogota - Santa Fe (Bogota, D.C.), a group of demonstrators, including unionized teachers at the SENA Educational Institute, marched to the intersection of Carrera 7 and Calle 32 in protest over unspecified demands.

label: P
text: On 28 February 2025, maybe three dozen demonstrators rallied in La Jolla Village in San Diego (California) to wave Ukrainian flags in support of Ukraine and call for peace between Ukraine and Russia. The rally included the House of Ukraine and Ukrainian Americans.

label: P
text: On 22 July 2025, civil society members and trade associations took out a protest rally in Tando Allahyar city (Tando Allah Yar, Sindh), denouncing Israeli airstrikes and expressing solidarity with the people of Palestine in Gaza.

label: P
text: On 1 May 2025, in Ocana (Norte de Santander), demonstrators marched to commemorate International Workers' Day. Similar marches took place in many cities across the country that day (coded separately).

label: R
text: On 24 September 2025, in Santiago de Cali - Comuna 17 (Valle del Cauca), hooded students at the Universidad del Valle (UNIVALLE) detonated low-power explosive devices and clashed with UNDMO police forces during a demonstration over unspecified issues near the Melendez campus. UNDMO police employed tear gas to disperse them and shut down public transportation nearby the premises. There were no casualties.

label: R
text: On 16 December 2024, members of RPI (Athawale) vandalized a BEST bus in the Chembur area of Mumbai Suburban - Kurla city (Mumbai Suburban, Maharashtra) during a demonstration against the custodial death of a Dalit man in Parbhani (coded separately). Police arrested two RPI (Athawale) men in connection with the incident.

label: R
text: On 11 November 2024, rioters burned tires and blocked the Batin Al Jabal road in Badr (Nalut, West) over the abduction of the security director of the intelligence services on 6 November (coded separately).

label: R
text: On 24 March 2025, in Marechal Deodoro (Alagoas), residents demonstrated in the city center, in front of BRK Ambiental's headquarters. The group burned tires and other objects on the road to denounce the lack of water distribution in their region for the past 15 days.

label: R
text: On 11 April 2025, people (likely from the Muslim community based on location and reason) held a demonstration and vandalised houses and vehicles at Betbona village in Samserganj tehsil (Murshidabad district, WB) against the Waqf amendment bill.

label: R
text: On 25 November 2024, in Bogota - Santa Fe (Bogota, D.C.), a group of hooded women participating in a demonstration threw Molotov cocktails at an adult cinema on 7th Avenue and 23rd Street, causing a fire. A security guard at the scene was injured. This was part of the demonstrations marking the International Day for the Elimination of Violence against Women. There were no fatalities.

label: R
text: Around 9 September 2025 (as reported), members of Kumabla Janakeeya Samithi (people's forum), IUML including MLAs took out a demonstration march to a temporary toll plaza on the national highway 66 at Kumbla town (Kasaragod, Kerala) against the construction of the toll booth. The demonstration destroyed the barricades set up by the police. The police used water cannons to disperse the demonstration.

label: R
text: On 12 September 2025, in Salvador - Itapua (Bahia), a group demonstrated in the Bairro da Paz neighborhood, on the Paralela Avenue to demand medical assistance for a man who is waiting for a hospital bed. The group burned objects on the road.

label: R
text: On 20 August 2025, hundreds of villagers blocked the road, clashed with steel plant officials and police, and held a demonstration at Alkusa village (Bokaro district, Jharkhand), demanding priority in employment. One policeman was injured.

label: R
text: On 12 April 2025, people (likely from the Muslim community based on location and reason) held a demonstration and vandalised a block development office at Jalangi town (Murshidabad district, WB) against the Waqf amendment bill.

label: E
text: On 26 June 2025, BLA militants attacked the main camp and convoy of the Pakistani army by firing several shells and launching a grenade attack in the Kalat area (Kalat, Balochistan). While the BLA claimed that the military forces suffered casualties and material losses as a result of the attack. Casualties unknown.

label: E
text: On 7 May 2025, BLA militants detonated an IED targeting a military supply vehicle in Sah Dim area of Zamuran tehsil (Kech, Balochistan), while it was en route to a security check post. The vehicle was damaged in the attack. BLA claim at least two military personnel were killed and three others were wounded. Fatalities uncorroborated with 2 fatalities coded and 3 injured.

label: E
text: On 2 March 2025, in San Pablo (Teorama, Norte de Santander), two soldiers were injured after stepping on a landmine planted by an unidentified armed group. They were airlifted to hospital for treatment. There is an ongoing dispute between the ELN and FARC dissident structures in the area. There were no fatalities.

label: E
text: On 4 May 2025, two children were killed when a mortar shell fired by military forces, targeting militants (coded as TTP), accidently hit them in Dray Chowk in Warsak area of Tirah Valley (Khyber, KPK). 2 fatalities.

label: E
text: On 20 February 2025, in Saravena (Arauca), two suspects on a motorcycle hurled a grenade at the local police station. Its detonation left a police officer injured. Although there has been no official confirmation at this time, police suspect the attack may be linked to the 51st anniversary of the killing of a historical ELN leader, likely indicating the involvement of this group. There were no fatalities.

label: E
text: On 21 February 2025, a District Reserve Guard (DRG) jawan was injured in an Improvised Explosive Device (IED) explosion triggered by Naxal-Maoist cadres in the forest area between Toymeta and Kawanar in Narayanpur district (Chhattisgarh), when the personnel were out on a patrol operation.

label: E
text: On 31 May 2025, unidentified militants (coded as Baloch Separatists) blew up a gas pipeline in Dera Murad Jamali (Nasirabad, Balochistan) with explosives. The gas pipeline was shut off at the time.

label: E
text: On 21 April 2025, in a rural area of Rioblanco municipality (Tolima), members of the Ismael Ruiz FARC dissident front detonated an explosive device on a bridge connecting Rioblanco with the El Gaitan and El Quebradon veredas. There were no casualties.

label: E
text: On 24 December 2024, militants (coded as TTP) detonated an IED planted along an under-construction road and targeted a police patrol vehicle in Kaki area (Bannu, KPK). The vehicle was partially damaged in the explosion, with all personnel unhurt in the vehicle. No casualties.

label: E
text: On 6 June 2025, in Santiago de Cali - Comuna 12 (Valle del Cauca), unidentified assailants hurled a grenade at the Villahermosa prison premises. The detonation injured six people, four prison guards and two civilians, and caused some material damage. The attack is suspected to be linked to the recent announcement of the extradition of the La Inmaculada gang leader to the United States. There were no fatalities.

label: V
text: On 3 June 2025, BLA militants claimed to have killed an informant working for the military near Tariq Hospital on Sariab Road in Quetta city (Quetta, Balochistan). The deceased was accused of recruiting informants for the army by luring and deceiving people. 1 fatality, 1 injured.

label: V
text: Around 23 June 2025 (as reported), ISIS militants (coded as ISPP) killed a young painter around the Spalanji area (Dasht (Mastung), Mastung, Balochistan). The security forces recovered the boy's body in a mutilated condition after they were informed of the body's location. The boy had been previously kidnapped from the Quetta area.

label: V
text: On 22 May 2025, intervening night, military forces detained and forcibly disappeared a Baloch youth from his residence in Quetta city (Quetta, Balochistan), during a raid. Local sources claim that six vehicles surrounded the house, entered the house, and 'beat' relative members. No fatalities.

label: V
text: On 18 March 2025, in Las Animas (Antioquia), an unspecified number of suspected members of an armed group shot and killed two optometrists who had been conducting eye exams for the local population that day. It is suspected that the health workers had not received authorization from the armed group to perform those tests. 2 fatalities.

label: S
text: On 25 April 2025, in Naucalpan de Juarez, Mexico, officers of the Secretariat of Public Safety (SSC) of Ciudad de Mexico and agents of the Attorney General's office, supported by military and National Guard officers, arrested one of the leaders of La Union Tepito in a house on Lomas Verdes avenue, in Colonia Lomas Verdes. The arrestee suspectedly led a drug trafficking faction that operated in Gustavo A. Madero and Cuauhtemoc, Ciudad de Mexico.

label: S
text: Defusal: On 9 March 2025, CRPF battalions 203, 209, 26, 60, 134, 174, 193, and 197, and district police seized a 3 kg Improvised Explosive Device (IED) planted by Naxal-Maoist cadres in the Lajamgudi and Jhingaburu forest areas (coded to Chaibasa, West Singhbhum district, Jharkhand), during an anti-Naxal opeartion. BDS personnel subsequently defused the IED.

label: S
text: On 17 October 2024, police personnel arrested 92 students in Lala Musa town (Gujrat, Punjab), for attacking police and damaging college buildings during the violent demonstrations against the rape of a college student in Lahore (coded separately).

label: S
text: Weapons seizure: On 4 June 2025, Special Operations Group, CRPF, and CoBRA personnel recovered 700 kg of looted explosives with the form of gelatine sticks in Saranda forest along the Odisha-Jharkhand border (coded to Chaibasa, West Singhbhum, Jharkhand). The explosives were looted by Naxal-Maoist cadres on 27 May (coded earlier).

label: S
text: Around 12 August 2025 (as reported), in Aguascalientes state, 27 members of the CJNG were arrested by the authorities. According to US authorities, this action was made due to the training provided by the INL and the FBI.

label: S
text: Defusal: On 27 October 2024, in Santiago Tangamandapio, Michoacan de Ocampo, state police officers deactivated an explosive that was thrown on the side of the highway La Cantera-Patamban highway.

label: V
text: Around 23 April 2025 (as reported), in Candeias (Bahia), CV members shot and killed a man in the Santo Antonio neighbourhood. The victim was on his way to visit his girlfriend when the suspects approached him and took his phone. They saw pictures of the victim doing an appropriated rival gang symbol (BDM) and killed him. The victim's body was later found in a remote area. The suspects escaped. 1 fatality.

label: V
text: On 2 February 2025, four to five Naxal-Maoist cadres abducted and axed to death a villager and left the corpse along the Tandwa-Balumath border (Chatra, Jharkhand), over suspicion of being a police informer. The victim had gone to the forest to graze cattle.

label: V
text: On 26 September 2025, a Baloch person was killed by unidentified armed persons claimed to have belonged to the military and state-backed 'death squads' (coded as pro-government militia) and his 'tortured' body was recovered in Buleda tehsil (Kech, Balochistan). The individual is claimed to have been abducted by military and death squad personnel the same day. 1 fatality.

label: V
text: Around 17 September 2025 (between 16 - 18 September), cadres of the Malajkhand unit of the CPI (Maoist)'s Gondia-Rajnandgaon-Balaghat division killed a villager in the forests of Chauria village under Lanji police station limits (Balaghat district, Madhya Pradesh), on suspicion of being a police informer after abducting him on 16 September (coded separately). His body was found on 18 September.

label: V
text: Around 2 September 2025 (as reported), in Eunapolis (Bahia), CV members abducted three women. The head of one victim was found in the Santa Lucia neighbourhood alongside a note saying that she had betrayed the CV and warning that this would be the fate of anyone who did the same. The bodies of the other two women are still missing. Police are investigating whether the victims were having relationships with BDM members who were shot and killed earlier on that same day (coded separately) and were victims of a drug trafficking tribunal. 1 fatality.

label: V
text: On 24 January 2025, in Coatzacoalcos, Veracruz de Ignacio de la Llave, two members of the Jalisco New Generation Cartel (CJNG) shot and killed a lawyer when he left his house on Timon street, in Colonia Puerto Esmeralda. One of the perpetrators was arrested on 23 June 2025. 1 fatality.

label: S
text: On 12 July 2025, 23 Naxal-Maoist cadres, including 14 men and 9 women with a cumulative bounty of Rs 1.18 crore, surrendered in Sukma district (Chhattisgarh).

label: S
text: On 11 July 2025, forces led by Osama Al Juwaili took control of the Ghadamis Border Crossing (Nalut, West) (near the Debdeb border crossing with Algeria), which had previously been held by GNU-aligned Border Guards forces. There were no clashes. A day earlier, Juwaili's forces had seized the nearby city of Ghadamis (coded separately).

label: S
text: Movement of forces: On 19 May 2025, a military cargo aircraft belonging to Haftar's Libyan National Army (LNA) flew, for the second time in a week, from Benina airport to Sirte airport (Surt, West). The cargo on the plane is unknown, but the movement took place amid an LNA military buildup in Sirte following recent armed clashes in Tripoli (all coded separately).

label: S
text: Around 14 October 2024 (between 11 - 18 October), in an unspecified location of Bogota, D.C. municipality (coded to Bogota), the government of Colombia and EMBF FARC dissidents held a sixth round of peace talks, reaching an agreement to extend the ceasefire between them for an additional six months, until 15 April 2025, and to increase cooperation to prevent armed clashes and facilitate the release of hostages.
